name: validation-depth
rule_r14: Validation depth is computed once per edge, frozen into the plan before any mutation, and never lowered afterwards.
computation: DEPTH = MAX(edge class floor, residual risk, impact severity, policy minimum)

escalation_triggers.trigger: Any accepted AI-authored repair on the edge
HIGH impact touching security, persistence or transactions
Configuration property migration affecting a bound key
Measured impact recall below the policy floor

unreachable_depth.never: Pass the edge at a lower depth than the one frozen for it

lowering_depth: Requires a new run with a new plan and a recorded decision. There is no runtime path that lowers a frozen depth.

test_validation.expected_framework_change_requires: A VERIFIED migration fact whose subject appears in the failure detail
test_validation.intentionally_changed_contract_requires: A signed approval naming that test
forbidden_autonomous_actions: Narrowing instrumentation scope to hide a regression
